findings.evidence: tests/packed/s13ResourceStabilityCampaign.mjs: when an iteration observes a non-terminal operation the loop sets `preserved=true` and breaks (lines 196-200), but reconciliation still runs by default (`if (harvest || !keepRoot) reconciliation = await reconcile()`, line 222; S13_RESOURCE_KEEP defaults unset) and reconcile() archives every owned workspace and agent under the shared root unconditionally (lines 122-150) with no terminality predicate.
